description: DRAFT. A guardian holding a threshold share of the user's recovery secret. The namespace org.ligatureprotocol is a placeholder; the domain is not yet registered.

main.description: Record of one guardian in the user's recovery set. The share itself is never stored here in plaintext.

guardianDid.description: DID of the guardian. Guardians are LP identities in this draft.

shareIndex.description: Index of the Shamir share held by this guardian.

encryptedShare.description: The share encrypted to the guardian (MLS-encrypted payload); opaque to the PDS.

lastLivenessAt.description: Last time a liveness check with this guardian succeeded.

lastRefreshAt.description: Last time this guardian's share was proactively refreshed.

policy.description: Recovery policy for the device set.

delaySeconds.description: Mandatory delay before recovery completes, during which existing devices may veto.
